subject: Document Upload Confirmation - $document_type
body:
Dear $student_name,

This email confirms that your document has been successfully uploaded to the system.

Document Details:
- Type: $document_type
- Document ID: $document_id
- Version: $version
- Upload Date: $upload_date
- Filename: $filename

Your document will be reviewed shortly. You will receive a notification once the review is complete.

Thank you for your submission.

$signature
